current.text: He is projected as Cleveland's sixth man. The projected starters are James Harden, Donovan Mitchell, Peyton Watson, Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen, and the projected bench is Tyson, Merrill, Bryant, Tomlin and Porter.
Cleveland lost Dennis Schroder, Keon Ellis, Max Strus and Dean Wade, all rotation players. The Strus trade partly cleared space for Tyson.
The experts expect a much bigger role in his third season. His minutes should stay high, and he could play close to starter's minutes off the bench.
Harden is in Cleveland for a full season next to Mitchell, so more players need the ball.
Last season he shot about 45% from three, up from 35% the year before. Over his final 16 games he shot 37%.

The experts agree that the 45% three-point shooting will not repeat. Danny thinks above 40% is possible. Josh is not convinced that the minutes will turn into fantasy value, because much of his value came from hot shooting.
In a bench role he projects around rank 150 to 170. If a player ahead of him misses about 20 games, he would finish well above that.
He is a late-round swing pick and a flyer if his role grows. He matters more in 14-team and deeper leagues.
Danny says his next step is to average 15 to 16 points on good efficiency as a secondary creator.
Cleveland has the most back-to-backs in the league. With a March 28 end, they play 4, 3 and 2 games in fantasy playoff weeks 19 to 21, so there is only a two-game week in the finals.

durable.text: His production was strong when teammates such as Strus, Hunter and Wade were out, and it faded when they returned.
He has had a high passing turnover rate and low assist numbers.
He can cover positions one through three.

note: Tyson is priced at 0 USD on Yahoo (rank 231) and ESPN (rank 191). The experts project him around rank 150 to 170 as a sixth man, which puts him just outside the 144 players our league drafts. He is a last-dollar flyer at most and mainly a waiver watch. His category profile has no outlier: assists are his weakest category, and turnovers stay low. Early in the season, check whether his minutes stay close to a starter's load, whether his three-point shooting holds near 40%, and whether Harden, Mitchell or Watson miss time. His two-game finals week makes him a weak hold for the fantasy playoffs.
